packageRules.description: Automerge routine updates once CI is green; majors stay manual

The project ships Boot 3 and Boot 4 module lines deliberately — Boot/SCG majors are framework migrations, not routine bumps. The Gradle plugin is listed by its marker name too: without it the Boot plugin's v4 major got through (#223).
The samples are Boot 3 consumers. Keep their Boot plugin and BOM on 3.x.

Spring Cloud 2025.1 (Oakwood) targets Boot 4; on the Boot 3 samples it fails at startup with NoClassDefFoundError: ServerProperties (#216). Renovate calls 2025.0 -> 2025.1 a minor, so the major rule above does not catch it.

The Boot 3 line pins DGS 10.x (dgs10) next to the Boot 4 pin (dgs) of the same artifact. DGS 11+ targets Boot 4 and breaks the Boot 3 modules at startup (#273), so only the 10.x pin is held to its major.
Same for springdoc: springdoc2 (2.x) serves Boot 3, springdoc (3.x) Boot 4. springdoc 3 on the Boot 3 modules fails startup (#275).

The fallback-jdk21 CI job installs JDK 21 on purpose, as the test launcher that keeps the serde fallback paths honest (every other setup-java step is 25). Renovate read that pin as a dependency and proposed 25 (#338).

This project's own modules. Renovate resolves them on Maven Central and proposed moving the project version itself (#234). The version changes only in the release commit, and the sample/BOM pins by hand as part of a release.
